result.markdown:
## Where to look

The best place to start is the Kennel Club's [Find a Puppy](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/find-a-puppy/) service. You can also try [Blue Staffy UK](https://www.bluestaffyuk.uk/uk-locations/) or Pets4Homes.

- **Cheap Pups** — [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/example-profile/) (phone, email, WhatsApp link and street address dropped).
- **UK Staffy Pups** — https://ukstaffypups.uk/puppies

### What to ask the breeder

| Question | Why |
|---|---|
| Are the parents DNA tested for L2HGA? | Hereditary disease |
| Can I see mum? | Welfare |

Ask for a written contract and check the breeder's council licence. The dam's temperament matters. Ask about the coefficient of inbreeding (COI).
